description: ODF .NET is an Open Document Format library for .NET, supporting the standard as defined by the OASIS Open Document Format committee. It lets you create, modify and parse ODF text documents (.odt) and spreadsheets (.ods) programmatically — paragraphs, text formatting and styles, headings, bullets and numbering, tables, images and shapes, text boxes, headers and footers, sections, bookmarks, hyperlinks, fields and document variables, footnotes, endnotes and annotations, track changes, page setup, cell formatting, defined names, formulas and content validation. Documents can be exported to PDF, HTML, RTF, Markdown and plain text, and text can be found and replaced with full formatting control. The library does not require OpenOffice, LibreOffice or any other third party application to be installed.
